{{Quote|You will come with us. Leave all weapons aboard your ship. The Jedi may keep their lightsabers.|The clone sergeant, to the freelance agents|<ref name="Outward Bound (Living Force adventure)" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''clone sergeant''' was based on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[New Dawn (space station)|''New Dawn'']], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military installation that was located in the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] traveled to ''New Dawn'' at the behest of the station's [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Renij Jaa]]. The [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]] commanded a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that were sent to greet the agents and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] escorted them to a conference room, where Jaa met with the agents. Once Jaa had finished speaking to the agents, he signaled to the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] to lead them to their [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
